summary: Globavend Holdings, via wholly-owned subsidiary Risemind Holdings (Cayman) Limited, acquired 70% of Loomi Entertainment Group Limited for nominal cash consideration of US$70, closing on May 19, 2026. The seller was Zenith Green Limited; remaining 30% is held by Fuk Yan Tse (Sharon), who was appointed CEO of Loomi Group. A price per share is not applicable due to the nominal structure; no premium is stated. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transaction closed immediately, and the filing updates a prior Form 6-K. Watch for integration risks and the impact of the AI-driven entertainment pivot on Globavend's core logistics business.
